items.title: Peter Bocage Interview, 1962-02-06
items.q: Lee Collins, well he was right from here too. They started right around here.

ctx.x: Did he have any distinctive style of playing?

Well, blues, you know, blues style. He used to do some fast fingering on us. He used to do some other boy too, but he died in Chicago there. Lee Collins, well he was right from here too. They started right around here.
Tell me, in all these bands, like the Pierron band and things like that, did they ever have drum solos? Hmm? Did they ever have drum solos in any of these bands?
